gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-montserrat-alter: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans draws its heading with a constant, stencil-cut weight and no pinched curves. Balsamiq Sans carries the shout; Montserrat Alternates carries the tall, round-bowled text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-newsreader: Wire-like and loud, Balsamiq Sans holds one constant line with no pinched curves. Newsreader moves in a reading rhythm of soft, heavier accents, its curves open-jawed and refined.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 is dignified, with a slight tightening at curve tops. Page after page the text reads with hairlines only a shade lighter than the stems, while Balsamiq Sans stays flat and unmodulated up top.
gen-gf-barriecito-archivo: Ladle-bowled, big-bodied lowercase in Barriecito, loud and distinctive. Archivo reads like an editorial column, its curves opening outward and its commanding x-height keeping paragraphs comfortably sturdy.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-asap: Tipped-ladle bowls and a fat lowercase make Barriecito loud, with compact capitals standing close beside it. Asap's near-capital body height gives that showy heading something steady to stand on.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Open bowls tipped like a ladle define Barriecito. Be Vietnam Pro, a sans-serif of plain constant-width lines and curve endings that never touch, makes the showy heading easy to live with.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and unclamped, tall-bodied with stubby ascender tips. Its wire-like monoline skeleton leaves Barriecito, with its open ladle-shaped bowls, free to be the showy one on the page.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-fira-sans: Clean and wide-opening, Fira Sans draws every glyph with an unmodulated line. Barriecito's big-bodied lowercase and open bowls take the spotlight above, while Fira's large x-height keeps the text steady.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-merriweather-sans: Barriecito's open bowls tip toward you like a ladle, with a big-bodied lowercase and compact capitals. Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, large-looking words, with an e that opens clearly to the right, steadying the showy heading.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-ranade: Widely spaced lines with weight that shifts like stretched rubber cord, only slightly, make the text feel organic. Ranade keeps its thins from ever turning spindly, leaving Barriecito's open ladle bowls to carry the show.
